comparison.objective: Align and trim a card to length on a guillotine cutter.
comparison.physical_skill: Card positioning and squaring, guarded handle actuation, and hand-clearance discipline.
comparison.success_condition: Card aligned and cut with blade down; unsafe hand entry never occurs; card and blade released and still for 1 s.
comparison.reason: The task tests measurement-guided cutting and safety-zone compliance, not precision component transfer or loose-element preservation.
